table.name: TLGNC_SHIPTO_SAREA_REST_MAINT
table.description: Description: Stores couples of sap contract items: LRQ 220.8 The master data shipto defaults of the MATCH_SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM_ID had been copied for SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM_ID by the automatic initialization of shipto sales area defaults scheduled job at the PROCESSING_TS. The key data of the contracts is identical. Populated only in SAP import.

column.name: SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM_ID
column.description: FK, unique TLGNS_SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM. Contract item id of the contract item, for which all the shipto sales area defaults of MATCH_SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM_ID had been copied during the automatic maintenance of shipto sales area default scheduled job.

column.name: MATCH_SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM_ID
column.description: FK, unique, FK TLGNS_SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM. Contract item id of the contract item, all the shipto sales area defaults of which were copied and assigned to SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM_ID during the automatic initialization of shipto sales area default scheduled job.

column.name: PROCESSING_TS
column.description: Empty whenever the SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM_ID is not yet processed by the automatic maintenance of shipto sales area defaults scheduled job. Contains the value of processing when the SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM_ID had been processed by the automatic initialization of shipto sales area defaults job.
